objective_contribution: Test whether exact-generation deterministic process state helps GLM-5.3-flash resume useful reasoning after actual local recycling at 8K and improves native ContextBench evidence selection within the same cumulative model input plus output token cap.

question_and_hypotheses.question: After actual local recycling, does exact-generation event-derived state improve native evidence selection without speculative tokenizer work within the same cumulative model-token cap?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: D07/D08 work binding, tokenizer-only initial-envelope and state-path health preflights, exact source closure, and freeze-phase continuity review remain before dispatch.

measurement_mapping.native: Paired ContextBench span and file metrics measure source-evidence selection; they do not establish repair correctness or semantic retention by themselves.
measurement_mapping.retention: A successful post-recycle model request bound to an exact-generation state presentation establishes mechanism exposure; useful retention additionally requires improved native outcomes or completed correctness evidence.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Every projected fact must bind to task input, successful request receipt, tool event, or repository result; unused-generation measurements and unmatched presentations are instrument failures.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count every model input and output token, including state presentation, recovery, failed submissions, and corrections. Local deterministic work is free until model-visible under the selected optimization cost.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development round cannot establish another window, model, domain, full-cohort result, semantic retention, or repair correctness.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter first; 8K development before 10K/12K and reserved confirmation.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through six and the eight round-four development identities are exposed. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, replacement, source refresh, threshold changes, or lucky reruns. Pause unstarted cells on shared provider or instrument failure and retain every attempt.

retained_counterevidence: Round four exposed source-index recovery but gained only 0.000819 macro span F1, lost 0.01333 file F1, and used 77,656 more aggregate model tokens.
Round five repaired terminal validity on a three-task exposed cohort; valid serialization did not establish useful state, semantic retention, or repair correctness.

Round six attempted three of sixteen cells, used 21,019 known model tokens plus one unknown-usage call, produced zero native scores and zero state presentations, and retained thirteen unstarted cells.
Both round-six treatment attempts performed speculative future-generation state measurement and failed before exposure, so H11 remains untested rather than supported or refuted.
Exact-generation state may remain distracting or insufficient even when its exposure and accounting are valid.
successor_rule: Freeze H13 only after exact-generation controls, matched design, preflights, exact source closure, D07/D08 work binding and freeze continuity pass. Run each frozen cell once. A passing exposed development result may prepare untouched confirmation under the unchanged acceptance contract; any failure or inconclusive result must retain evidence and select a reviewed competing successor. Never rerun unchanged, lower thresholds, infer clearance, or transition automatically to another benchmark.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: H13 tests reusable reasoning continuity, recovery, correctness-oriented completion and outcomes under total model-token cost.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: H13 directly tests GLM-5.3-flash after recycling at 8K; later small windows remain ordered after valid 8K evidence.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench acceptance contract remains the uncleared milestone; development evidence cannot clear it.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The reviewed round-six zero-exposure failure leads through an explicit gap, question, H13/H12/H0 selection, fixed experiment and future observation/decision chain.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Prior weak quality gains, added tokens, terminal-only validity, round-six failures and the semantic ceiling are retained.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native selection, exact exposure, integrity, correctness limits and cumulative model input plus output tokens are separated.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Only exposed 8K development tasks are used; SWE-bench is excluded and full identities, windows, tiers and reserved repetitions remain unchanged.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H13 has one changed variable, exact exposure checks, matched controls, fixed thresholds, falsifiers and stopping rules.
